name: intent
what: Something we want changed that needs your Gate A: its problem, claims, checkpoints, questions for you and its history.

fields.name: problem
fields.means: who, what they experience, evidence, whys to the root, truths, assumptions, risk

fields.name: claims
fields.means: promises, each with how it could fail and its check

fields.name: checkpoints
fields.means: smallest slices, each with its claims

fields.name: questions
fields.means: what only you can answer, asked in chat

fields.name: events
fields.means: the trace, append-only: when, who, what, how, the docs it wrote (writes) and the sources it read or tried to (reads), and a line of text; the step is computed from the events before it
